newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: ASX substantial shareholding notices - Aug 15.
newsitem.headline: ASX substantial shareholding notices - Aug 15.

text.p: The following substantial shareholder notices were made to The Australian Stock Exchange (ASX) yesterday.
The Capital Group Companies, Inc increased its relevant interest in WMC Limited on 13/08/1997, from 71,878,201 ordinary shares (6.43%) to 88,045,225 ordinary shares (7.80%).
ANZ Executors and Trustee Company Ltd increased its relevant interest in Lemarne Corporation Limited on 18/11/1996, from 1,035,973 ordinary shares (6.27%) to 1,200,265 ordinary shares (7.27%).

UPL Equities P/L became a substantial shareholder in Collins Motor Corporation Limited on 12/08/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 11,250,000 ordinary shares (21.13%).
Ted Teng Beng became a substantial shareholder in Collins Motor Corporation Limited on 08/08/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 4,000,000 ordinary shares (7.5%).
Seam Gak San decreased its relevant interest in Collins Motor Corporation Limited on 12/08/1997, from 6,000,000 ordinary shares (14.4%) to 4,475,000 ordinary shares (8.40%).
UPL Equities P/L decreased its relevant interest in Collins Motor Corporation Limited on 12/08/1997, from 11,250,000 ordinary shares (21.13%) to Nil ordinary shares (Nil%).
